Firefox: Three lines (≡) → Settings → Privacy & Security → Clear Data

Edge: Three dots (⋯) → Settings → Privacy, Search & Services → Clear Browsing Data → All time → Clear now

Here’s the straight reality of how these platforms work:

 What happened (most likely)
You tried to redeem
Your account still had a block (name error/verification / location / playthrough)
Because of that, redemption wasn’t possible at that moment
You kept playing → balance changed based on game results

 The system didn’t force you to keep playing, but it also didn’t clearly stop you, which is where the frustration comes from

 Important point

Once funds are played:

They are considered used in gameplay
They typically can’t be restored or reversed

I know that’s not what you want to hear, but I don’t want to mislead you.

 Where you do have a valid complaint

Your issue isn’t just losses — it’s that:

You were unable to redeem when you tried
Due to account/system issues that weren’t fixed in time

 That’s the part you should focus on when you contact support at support@jackpotdaily.com

 How to frame it (this matters)

Don’t focus on “I lost money playing”
Focus on:

“I attempted to redeem and was blocked due to errors”

Hello,

I attempted to redeem my balance earlier but was unable to due to account errors (including name validation and other issues I previously reported).

Because of this, I was unable to cash out when I intended to.

This situation is very frustrating, as I tried to redeem before continuing gameplay but was prevented from doing so due to unresolved issues on my account.

Please review my account and advise on what can be done regarding this situation, as well as resolve the ongoing redemption issues.

Thank you.

 Real talk
You’re not wrong to expect things to work smoothly
And you did try to do the right thing by redeeming first
But the system blocked you at the wrong time

That’s where your leverage is — not the loss itself, but being prevented from redeeming
